name: GTEx (Genotype-Tissue Expression)

version.value: v11 (946 subjects, 54 tissues, 50 eQTL tissues, GRCh38, GENCODE v47); v10 also available

scope: Bulk RNA-seq expression and eQTL/sQTL resources across non-diseased tissues, plus long-read, single-cell and haplotype-expression collections in the open bucket.
mapping_methods: GRCh38 genotypes with GENCODE gene annotation.

quantitative.summary: TPM, read counts, eQTL effect sizes and p-values.

licence.name: Open-access files free to download; raw sequence and full donor metadata are protected (dbGaP/AnVIL)
licence.redistribution: Open-access derivatives allowed with acknowledgement; protected data excluded
licence.note: Exact reuse wording on the documentation page was not parsed.

update_frequency: Major releases every few years (v8 2019, v10, v11).
coverage_limitations: About 950 donors (946 subjects, 943 with eQTL data in release v11); donor ancestry composition is not recorded in the stored evidence and is unverified here
Sampling conditions (including post-mortem collection) are described in the GTEx publications and were not retrieved here; some tissues have few samples
Only open-access data are available here
known_omissions: Rare-variant and ancestry-specific effects are underpowered

reuse_decision.rationale: Median expression table is small and fetched now. Large eQTL tables are available but Open Targets and eQTL Catalogue provide fine-mapped, harmonised versions; pull only what is needed.

status.notes: API v2 dataset list and bucket listing verified.

unverified_fields: coverage_limitations (donor ancestry composition and sampling conditions are from the GTEx publications, not retrieved)

evidence_profile.biological_context: Bulk RNA-seq and whole-genome-sequencing genotypes from donors, across non-diseased tissues. Expression and QTL effects are averages over the cell types present in each tissue, and the number of donors differs between tissues.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Association statistics per tissue; release v11 lists 946 subjects (943 with eQTL data) in 54 tissues, 50 of them with eQTL results. Fine-mapping and colocalisation are needed before causal claims.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low to moderate. An eQTL or sQTL associates a variant, or a linked variant, with expression or splicing in a tissue; allele-specific expression collections add allele-resolved support but remain observational.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: A molecular phenotype in non-diseased tissue; disease relevance needs colocalisation with a trait and the relevant cell type or state.
evidence_profile.absence_means: No eQTL in a tissue means none was detected at the available power in bulk tissue. Cell-type-specific, context-specific and rare-allele effects are not covered.
